description: Here’s a complete overview of its capabilities: 1. Dynamic Table Structure Multiple Columns: Supports dynamic addition and removal of columns, with customizable column titles (up to 20 columns). Manual and Data-Driven Rows: Displays both data-driven rows (from your dataset) and manual rows that can be added by the user for custom calculations, notes, or summaries. 2. Drag & Drop Row Reordering Reorder Rows: Users can drag and drop rows to reorder them within the table, including both data and manual rows. Multi-Column Support: Rows can be moved between columns, allowing for flexible organization of data. Optimistic UI: Changes are reflected immediately in the UI for a smooth user experience, and are persisted in Power BI after saving. 3. Inline Floating Toolbar for Row Formatting Contextual Toolbar: Clicking a row brings up a floating toolbar for quick formatting. Text Formatting: Change font size, font family, bold, and italic for both label and amount cells. Color Customization: Instantly change text color and background color for both label and amount cells using color pickers. Margin and Spacing: Adjust top and bottom margins for each row to control spacing. Custom Labels and Amounts: Rename any row or override its displayed value directly from the toolbar. Hide/Show Rows: Instantly hide or show any row without deleting data. 4. Advanced Format Pane Integration Full Format…
